article.story: CHATTANOOGA, Tenn. -- — Mathieu Grujicic scored 23 points as Radford beat Chattanooga 73-65 on Saturday. Grujicic added five rebounds for the Highlanders (2-4). Frederik Erichsen added 17 points, nine rebounds and five assists while going 6 of 14 from the floor, including 3 for 8 from 3-point range, and 2 for 7 from the free-throw line. Tristan Gross shot 4 for 6, including 2 for 4 from beyond the arc to finish with 10 points. Matt Hampton led the way for the Mocs (3-3) with 18 points. Chattanooga also got 13 points and six rebounds from Lenny Anigbata. Yonatan Levy finished with 10 points and four assists. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
